en_US.plugin_description: Search records across your internal NocoDB tables
en_US.base_url_tooltip: Your NocoDB origin, for example https://noco.example.com
en_US.api_token_tooltip: A NocoDB API token sent only to the configured server
en_US.tables_tooltip: Array of {id, name, titleField, searchFields}; optional color and urlTemplate fields are supported
en_US.result_score_tooltip: Score assigned to NocoDB records in global Wox search; higher values appear first
en_US.base_url_required: Configure the NocoDB server URL first
en_US.api_token_required: Configure a NocoDB API token first
en_US.tables_required: Configure at least one NocoDB table first

ru_RU.plugin_description: Поиск записей во внутренних таблицах NocoDB
